nodes.label: Markdown Contact Files (~/.contacts/)
nodes.rationale: One plain markdown file per person under ~/.contacts/, edited with Read/Write/Glob/Grep; no CLI, no database, no index. The roster is derived from the files themselves so nothing can fall out of sync. Personality and communication style matter most because they change how the agent talks to and about the person.

nodes.label: Nightly Capture and Reconcile Pass
nodes.rationale: The nightly dream runs one pass that captures the day's learnings into contact files and reconciles external sources (messaging apps, calendars, address books), with contacts as the hub of truth. Sync outward is non-destructive: fill gaps and fix stale data, never bulk-overwrite a service's data.

nodes.label: User Never Gets a Contact File
nodes.rationale: The user matters too much to page out to a file: their full profile, history, and texture live in MEMORY.md's USER PROFILE and stay in memory; contacts hold only the other people in the user's world.
